summary: Use effective recipe categories consistently for matching and acquisition.
details: Canonical category facts now follow the shared category resolver. An explicit plural list supersedes a stale singular category; an empty or malformed list cannot invent a crafting route.

Modeled recipe variants inherit parent categories only when neither variant field is declared. Candidate category indexes use the resolved variants, preserving legitimate routes while preventing phantom hand-crafting acquisition.

Controlled source checks exercise actual CompilerContext, canonical facts and acquisition decisions, with opposing category/variant cases and prototype immutability. Shared source is present in all nine targets; native catalogue, machine availability, production and save acceptance remain pending.
